SELECT o.org_id, o.legal_name,
       SUM(CAST(arb.remaining_balance AS REAL)) AS total_remaining_undisbursed
FROM organization o
JOIN award a ON a.org_id = o.org_id
JOIN award_remaining_balance arb ON arb.award_id = a.award_id
GROUP BY o.org_id, o.legal_name
ORDER BY o.org_id
tasks.unresolved_handling: All organizations and awards have established remaining_balance values in award_remaining_balance; no unresolved balances were encountered for this aggregation.

-- organization for A-101
SELECT o.* FROM organization o
JOIN award a ON a.org_id = o.org_id
WHERE a.award_id = 'A-101';

-- all awards of that organization
SELECT a.* FROM award a
JOIN award a0 ON a0.org_id = a.org_id
WHERE a0.award_id = 'A-101'
ORDER BY a.award_id;

-- all disbursements for those awards
SELECT d.* FROM disbursement d
JOIN award a ON a.award_id = d.award_id
JOIN award a0 ON a0.org_id = a.org_id
WHERE a0.award_id = 'A-101'
ORDER BY d.award_id, d.date;
tasks.unresolved_handling: Traversal uses established org_id links on award rows; all referenced awards and disbursements are present in the World.

tasks.code:
-- Active awards: status established via award_status_label (legend codes A/C only)
SELECT a.award_id, CAST(arb.remaining_balance AS REAL) AS remaining_balance
FROM award a
JOIN award_status_label asl ON asl.award_id = a.award_id
JOIN award_remaining_balance arb ON arb.award_id = a.award_id
WHERE asl.status_label = 'Active';

-- Unresolved status identities from purpose_requirement_failure
SELECT affected_identity, failure_kind, requirement_id
FROM purpose_requirement_failure
WHERE relation_name = 'award' AND requirement_id = 'award_status_interpretable';

-- Sibling awards of Active awards with uninterpreted status
SELECT DISTINCT s.award_id, s.org_id, s.status_code,
       CAST(arb.remaining_balance AS REAL) AS remaining_balance
FROM award active
JOIN award_status_label asl ON asl.award_id = active.award_id AND asl.status_label = 'Active'
JOIN award s ON s.org_id = active.org_id AND s.award_id != active.award_id
JOIN award_remaining_balance arb ON arb.award_id = s.award_id
WHERE s.award_id IN (
  SELECT affected_identity FROM purpose_requirement_failure
  WHERE relation_name = 'award' AND requirement_id = 'award_status_interpretable'
)
ORDER BY s.award_id;
tasks.unresolved_handling: Active status is limited to awards with an established label in award_status_label (codes A and C in status_legend_entry). Awards A-104 (code S) and A-105 (code H) are flagged UNINTERPRETED in purpose_requirement_failure and excluded from the Active total. Unresolved siblings are reported separately with their actual remaining_balance (not treated as zero). A-104 is unresolved but not a sibling of any Active award, so it is omitted from the sibling list.
